html:
Unique Research · Event · October 13, 2024 · Host: Unique Capital

As global demand for AI learning and exchange rises, Unique Capital opens a 2025 CES + AI study tour across San Francisco and Las Vegas for founders and practitioners. CES 2025 runs Jan 7–10 at the Las Vegas Convention Center. Before the show, Unique Capital partners lead Silicon Valley visits — face time with experts at Apple, Meta and peers; Stanford sessions on disruptive innovation; then deep CES walkthroughs with fellow entrepreneurs and executives.

Trip pillars

  1. CES — world’s flagship consumer-electronics show; Nvidia expected to unveil Blackwell RTX 50-series GPUs at CES 2025.
  2. AI-themed exchange with founders/execs; visit top U.S. AI labs/companies.
  3. Peer founder conversations in Silicon Valley.
  4. Stanford, Berkeley and professor/industry guest lectures.
  5. Silicon Valley tech-circle meetups.

Stop highlights

Meta (Facebook) — 3B+ MAU; Instagram/WhatsApp; VR / privacy agenda.

Apple — FY2023 rev $383.285B; Cupertino; first $2T (2020) / $3T (2022); ~$3.23T as of Jun 12, 2024.

FlashIntel.ai — AGI-driven GTM intel (FlashInfo + FlashClick); 6 countries / 7 offices; 100+ specialists; 3,000+ partners; $10M seed (Celtic House, Uphonest, Hat-Trick); Silicon Valley Review Top 50 Most Admired 2023.

Collov.ai — AI interior design + home commerce (2021, SV HQ + Beijing); tens of millions USD funding.

Palo Alto City Walk — Tesla, VMware, IDEO, Stanford neighborhood.

Stanford — QS 2024 #5; SLAC / Hoover.

Culture: Lombard Street, Fisherman’s Wharf / Pier 39.

Day-1 GenAI meetup salon — LLMs, vertical apps, networking with AI firms, experts, investors.

Detailed day-by-day itinerary lives in CN image boards (~12 imgs) — attach on import. Enrollment via Unique Capital outbound programs.

— END —
